evidence.source_title: Gentherm and Modine Manufacturing Company Announce Additional Information in Connection with Proposed Combination of Gentherm and Modine’s Performance Technologies Business
evidence.publisher_or_speaker: Gentherm Incorporated and Modine Manufacturing Company
evidence.summary: September 17, 2026 joint release describing the SpinCo distribution and merger sequence, expected October 1 closing, special dividend, exchange-ratio adjustment, revised SpinCo cash distribution and estimated post-close ownership.
extracted_facts: Modine plans to distribute Platinum SpinCo common stock to Modine shareholders and a Gentherm merger subsidiary is expected to merge with SpinCo immediately afterward.
The release estimates a $58,350,533 special Gentherm cash dividend, approximately $1.90 per share, conditioned on merger closing.

The release says the expected exchange-ratio adjustment would reduce the SpinCo cash distribution to Modine from $210 million to $159 million, add approximately 2,902,466 Gentherm shares, and produce expected ownership of approximately 56.4% existing Gentherm holders and 43.6% former SpinCo holders, excluding overlap.

evidence.source_title: Gentherm and Modine’s Performance Technologies Business to Combine, Establishing a Scaled Leader in Thermal Management Solutions
evidence.publisher_or_speaker: Gentherm Incorporated and Modine Manufacturing Company
evidence.summary: January 29, 2026 original transaction announcement identifying the deal as a Reverse Morris Trust intended to be tax-free to Modine and its shareholders for U.S. federal income tax purposes and describing the original transaction economics.
extracted_facts: The transaction was announced at approximately $1.0 billion value and approximately 6.8x LTM September 2025 post-synergy adjusted EBITDA.

Before later adjustment, Modine was expected to receive a $210 million SpinCo cash distribution and Modine shareholders approximately 21 million newly issued Gentherm shares representing approximately $790 million equity consideration.
Original expected ownership was approximately 60% Gentherm shareholders and 40% Modine shareholders, subject to adjustment.

evidence.source_title: Modine Manufacturing Company Form 8-K — September 17, 2026 transaction update
evidence.publisher_or_speaker: Modine Manufacturing Company filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
evidence.summary: Indexed SEC filing text describing the same RMT adjustment, additional Gentherm shares, reduced SpinCo cash distribution and expected 56.4%/43.6% post-close ownership. Its indexed text conflicts with the joint release on the special-dividend record date.
extracted_facts: The filing describes approximately 2,902,466 additional Gentherm shares expected from the exchange-ratio adjustment.
It describes reducing the SpinCo cash distribution from $210 million to $159 million and a special Gentherm dividend of approximately $58,350,533.
It describes expected post-close ownership of approximately 56.4% existing Gentherm holders and 43.6% former SpinCo holders, excluding overlapping ownership.
The indexed 8-K text states September 29, 2026 as the special-dividend record date, while the joint release states September 28, 2026; this was not reconciled in DISCOVERY.

payload.mechanism: A Reverse Morris Trust can separate a business from a parent while letting the parent’s shareholders retain a large equity interest in the acquirer/combined company; the separated business can also distribute cash to the parent, allowing portfolio focus and debt reduction without structuring the transaction as a simple all-cash asset sale.

case_specific_components.parent_cash_component: SpinCo cash distribution to Modine, currently estimated at $159 million after adjustment
case_specific_components.shareholder_rollover: Former SpinCo holders currently expected to own approximately 43.6% of the combined company, excluding overlap
case_specific_components.acquirer_holder_protection: Gentherm special dividend currently estimated at $58,350,533 accompanies the ownership/cash adjustment

payload.caveat: This is a structural inference from announced terms, not an independent tax/legal conclusion or a statement that final closing economics are fixed.

payload.finality: The release states the final exchange ratio, share issuance, cash-distribution reduction and dividend amounts will be determined at closing and may differ.

steps: Modine holds the Performance Technologies business in Platinum SpinCo Inc.
Modine distributes SpinCo common stock to Modine shareholders.
Immediately after the spin-off, Gentherm’s wholly owned Platinum Gold Merger Sub Inc. merges with SpinCo, completing the Reverse Morris Trust.
payload.shareholder_mechanics: Each Modine shareholder is announced to receive one SpinCo share for each Modine share held at the distribution record date; each SpinCo share then converts in the merger into Gentherm shares according to the exchange ratio.
payload.modine_share_continuity: Modine shareholders continue to hold the same number of Modine shares after the transaction while also receiving Gentherm shares through the SpinCo combination.
